title: add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Maya Chen
description: Adds a set of RAG templates, agent/tool-calling quickstarts, and docs-site updates to make it easier for developers to get started with Retrieval-Augmented Generation and tool-calling agents. Motivation: shipped as part of the developer docs initiative to reduce onboarding friction and provide vetted templates for common patterns (chat with RAG, cite sources, tool calling for search/actions). This PR includes: 1) three RAG templates (faq-bot, code-search-assistant, summarizer) with README and sample index configurations; 2) agent examples that demonstrate tool-calling (search, exec, analytics) and function signing; 3) docs site landing pages + quickstart walkthroughs with step-by-step instructions and sample responses; 4) small SDK example updates in redwood-examples to wire up the quickstarts; 5) minor static-site styling tweaks for code blocks and callouts. Checklist: [x] templates added [x] quickstarts added [x] docs pages written [x] examples wired to redwood-examples repo [x] docs site preview green Notes: kept runtime and infra changes minimal (examples use existing public models), focused on reproducible examples and CI preview.
